survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This factsheet reports PISA 2022 results for Moldova using the OECD PISA 2022 Database. The note describes that PISA uses complex sampling and that some countries/economies may have estimates marked with an asterisk when sampling standards were not met; for Moldova, the note states that all data met PISA quality standards and were fit for reporting. The factsheet does not provide the specific student weight variable name(s) (e.g., TOTWGT/W_FSTUWT) or replicate-weight method (e.g., BRR/jackknife), so the exact weighting implementation cannot be verified from the provided text. Analysts using the OECD database should apply the PISA-provided sampling weights and replicate weights as specified in the PISA technical documentation to obtain correct standard errors and confidence intervals for means and proficiency-level shares.

The factsheet does not describe additional exclusions beyond the PISA data-quality statement that all data met PISA technical standards for Moldova.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD PISA 2022 factsheet summarizes how 15-year-old students in Moldova performed in mathematics, reading, and science, and how results changed relative to earlier PISA cycles (notably 2010, 2015, and 2018). It reports mean performance trends and proficiency-level distributions (e.g., shares at or above Level 2 and Level 5/6) and compares Moldova to the OECD average and selected comparison countries. The assessment design uses two two-hour tests with different students receiving different combinations of subject test questions, plus a student background questionnaire and a school principal questionnaire. The factsheet also highlights within-country gaps by socio-economic status (ESCS quintiles and top/bottom 25%) and gender differences, and it reports contextual indicators such as belonging, discipline in mathematics lessons, safety/bullying, parental involvement, and COVID-related learning experiences. Moldova is stated to meet PISA quality standards for reporting; however, the factsheet does not provide the underlying PV/missing-data or weighting procedures in the excerpt.
